name: Trick Shot Cinema
summary: Trick Shot Cinema is a free daily movie-link puzzle played in the browser on phone or desktop. Each day you get three films: a Start, a Trick Shot and an End. Link Start to End through the Trick Shot, one person at a time. A link is anyone who worked on both films: cast, director, writer, composer. There is no cast list on screen. You name people and films from memory, and you get two peeks per game if you are stuck. The Daily is free and needs no sign-up. If you sign in, you get a ranked leaderboard, 1v1 challenges with friends and Screening Rooms for groups. There is also Party Mode, where friends pick the three films and everyone races, and a TV mode for game night.
